author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: id love this feature since i hate having to play with the mirrors grab feature to try to get it straight and lined up properly on a wall or on a window. toggling something similar to how you can keep the camera straight, but for the mirror would be great.
If (and only if) it's world-locked, it would also be nice to get it snapped to 12 rotation divisions around Y, similar to snap turning. That would make it easy to put against world walls.

details: Would love the option to force the personal mirror to align with the horizon as I find mirrors not perpendicular to the ground disorienting at times
title: Personal Mirror setting 'Level with Horizon'
